title: Query Tab Isolation & Bug Fixes
description: Improved query tab management with SSMS-style isolation and critical bug fixes for formula handling.

items.title: Query Tab Isolation & Results Panel
items.description: Query tabs now work like SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) with complete content isolation and improved results display.
details: Each query tab maintains its own independent content
Loading queries from history creates new isolated tabs
Results panel now has transparent, modern aesthetic
Reduced visual clutter with subtle borders and hover effects
Better integration with dark mode and light mode themes

items.title: Formula History & Query Execution
items.description: Fixed critical issues with formula saving and query execution in isolated tabs.
details: AI-generated formulas now save actual Excel formulas (e.g., '=B2*C2') instead of natural language
Run button correctly executes queries from active tab content
Fixed crash when loading queries from history
Formula queries properly switch to spreadsheet mode with AI enabled
